text:
nora: Recap from the DR postmortem — creating a focused thread for concrete follow-ups on multi-region failover, backups, and the next game-day. I'll collect owners here so we don't lose items in docs.

nora: Items I spotted: 1) verify cross-region backups + object versioning; 2) DNS TTL and healthcheck cadence for fast failover; 3) restore runbook gaps for table-level restores; 4) game-day checklist + chaos tests.

ben: I'll take the DNS/traffic side. Plan: publish canonical TTLs, add canary percentage steps (10% -> 50% -> 100%), and a rollback step that uses weighted record sets. ETA: 1813530000. I'll add a small k6 script to validate request distribution.

parveen: I'll own backup verification and the restore runbook corollary. Action: add a monthly dry-restore job that pulls latest snapshot to staging, verifies key tables and checksums, and records artifacts to S3 CRR bucket. ETA: 1813510000. Note: need to confirm bucket replication for ap-southeast-1.

ops-bot: scheduled_job: backup-dry-restore last_run=1813400000 status=success artifacts=/artifacts/backup-1813400000.tar.gz

nora: Good. Parveen, please include a short n/0 test for customer-facing tables and a quick schema diff step.

parveen: Will do. Also will add a section on encrypted snapshot handling: when CMK rotates, restore needs short-lived access. I'll list exact IAM roles required for ci-runner.

ben: For DNS, adding a pre-failover capacity check so we don't move traffic to a region that's already overloaded. That'll be a combined check: region CPU < 70% AND available GPU < X. If not met, fail failover and escalate.

product-ops: Heads-up: Product wants RTO = 15m for read-only and 60m for writable restores. Can we confirm those targets are realistic?

parveen: We'll validate during the dry-restore. If we can't hit 60m for full writable restore, we'll propose tiered plan.

nora: Add owners to the tracker doc I created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/dr-action-tracker-2026 — please comment on the row to ACK and set due_ts.

ben: ACK "DNS failover plan + canary script" assigned. due_ts=1813530000

parveen: ACK "Automated dry-restore + checksum" assigned. due_ts=1813510000

nora: Also: we saw repeated pattern of region flapping under high traffic -> add passive throttling and circuit breaker in routing policy. Ben, can you propose thresholds?

ben: I'll propose thresholds: 1000 concurrent streams/instance + 75% CPU threshold. Will add an experiment in staging to validate.

security-team: Quick note: if dry-restores expose PII in staging, we need tokenization or a scrub pipeline. Parveen, coordinate with security-team for masking rules.

parveen: Got it — I'll open a PR with scrub steps and sample scrub script before dry-restore job lands.

nora: Game-day: I'm proposing a 2-hour dry run with the following participants: DB lead (parveen), Routing (ben), comms (product-ops), observer set (oncall + PM). Tentative date: 1813620000. Volunteers?

ben: I'll participate and run routing steps.

parveen: I'll run DB restore and measure RTO.

product-ops: I'll manage external comms + status page updates.

nora: Great. I'll send invites and mark tracker rows "in progress". Please update row statuses as PRs land. If anyone hits blockers with permissions or access, ping @security-team or reply here.

ops-bot: reminder: upcoming job "backup-dry-restore" scheduled at 1813513600

ben: Small blocker — need a sandbox route table for the canary test. @eng-infra can you provision a routing sandbox?

nora: Noted, I'll loop infra and ping in #eng-infra.

nora: Closing for now; will reopen thread if any owner changes. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
